The Gremlin is level 5 and paper golems are level 3, so dogmove.c:dog_move’s full-health balk threshold permits the pet to attack; its peaceful-target skip applies only below one-quarter HP or to leaders/guardians. Three targets and 80 waits give the pet repeated attack sequences so the C trace can observe its fourth AD_CURS attack and subsequent ordinary kills. C run-g5VG6f reached mhitm_ad_curs at step 67 (rn2(10)=0) and make_corpse at steps 93, 123 and 152. The JS replay run-n8OgBF first diverges at C step 66, when C enters dogmove.c:dog_move -> mhitm.c:mattackm, and matches only 66/223 screens and 2733/5072 RNG calls. Keep /tmp/B64-mhitm-ad-curs-tame-gremlin-paper-golems-mondied-b64-C-only.session.json as the C-only artifact; do not add it under recordings/. The paper-golem recording does not cover the clay-golem-specific curse death arm. Seed 72904113 and clock 2039-03-27 22:30 were chosen independently to exercise nighttime AD_CURS.
